title: EVALID: A Pre-Registered Identifiability Protocol for Bounding Nuisance Capacity in Empirical Claims
description: EVALID fixes predictions, numeric thresholds and the resampling unit before data are loaded, publishes passes and failures alike, and logs every correction rather than repairing it silently. Version 0.3.2 requires a numerical uncertainty on every threshold comparison, introduces INDETERMINATE and UNDERDETERMINED verdict states, registers a condition-number ceiling in advance, and requires disclosure where the auditor is also the author of the audited object. Ships with a worked example: a pre-registered falsification audit in which the protocol was aimed at its own author's prior gravitational-wave dispersion proposal, and twelve of thirteen registered predictions failed.
